claim_boundary: Official documentation gives NFCI zero a publisher-defined economic meaning: positive is tighter-than-average and negative is looser-than-average U.S. financial conditions. Research also shows Bitcoin's monetary-policy response changes across regimes. Exactly one matched-capital audit may therefore test the static negative-NFCI admission state; neither the publisher nor the literature establishes BTC or DRA predictability.

feature_contract.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

prior_matrix.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, National Financial Conditions Index current data and methodology
prior_matrix.finding: The NFCI is a weekly dynamic-factor summary of money, debt, equity and banking conditions. It is released on Wednesday at 8:30 a.m. ET for the week ending the prior Friday, with Thursday publication possible around federal holidays. Positive readings are tighter than average and negative readings are looser than average.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The NFCI was not designed as a Bitcoin or DRA signal, is historically below zero most of the time and may be revised. A conservative seven-calendar-day lag is used rather than reconstructing exact holiday and daylight-saving release clocks.

prior_matrix.identity: Karau, Monetary policy and Bitcoin, Journal of International Money and Finance 137 (2023)
prior_matrix.finding: Bitcoin's response to U.S. monetary-policy shocks is time-varying: post-2020 tightening resembles other risky assets, while earlier responses differed and could have the opposite sign.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Identified monetary-policy surprises are not the NFCI level, and the paper does not establish a static zero-threshold admission rule or after-cost strategy performance.

prior_matrix.finding: FRED publishes the Chicago Fed NFCI as a weekly Friday-ending, not-seasonally-adjusted index and requires source attribution. The series notes define positive as tighter-than-average and negative as looser-than-average conditions.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The downloaded CSV is a present-vintage snapshot rather than an archive of original weekly releases; original values and revision vintages remain MISSING_PROOF.

real_time_design_requirements: Seal one exact FRED CSV response for NFCI from 2018-01-01 through 2024-12-31; require unique Friday observations, exact seven-day spacing, finite decimal values and no missing marker.

Make week-ending Friday D usable only at D plus seven calendar days 00:00 UTC and for at most 168 hours. This is later than normal Wednesday or holiday-Thursday publication and avoids reconstructing daylight-saving release times.
Admit an unchanged DRA V1 parent signal only when the latest eligible NFCI is strictly below zero; zero and positive values veto the new entry while leaving existing lots and exits untouched.
Use the frozen 250 USDT DRA V1 parent, 240 USDT slot capacity, 0.10% fee and 0.05% adverse slippage without changing entries, exits, lot size, capacity or accounting.

Require Design, Validation and 2020-2024 annual matched-capital economics, including realized, unrealized and total PnL, drawdown, underwater duration, holding, utilization, terminal inventory, intervention breadth, concentration and independent 168-hour predictive diagnostics.
Do not add ANFCI, NFCI subindexes, changes, moving averages, z-scores, alternate lags, nonzero thresholds, interactions, inverse rules, fractional sizing, short legs or post-outcome exceptions.
Do not open post-2024 data; a historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
uncertainty: Bitcoin's relationship with U.S. monetary and financial conditions changes across regimes and may reverse sign.
The NFCI contains market prices that can contemporaneously reflect BTC-relevant risk sentiment without necessarily forecasting future DRA paths.
The present-vintage FRED series can contain revisions; original release values and revision history remain MISSING_PROOF.
Negative NFCI is common, so the rule may intervene too rarely or simply reproduce broad risk-on participation.
No NFCI historical values, BTC/DRA outcome, post-2024 observation, candidate, OOS or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
